pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: apps/stage/src/voice/session.ts:200 The session throws away accept()'s result. If a middle part of a line fails to decode, the player returns "bad" and still schedules the line's later parts, so a sentence is skipped silently: no health event, no report to the daemon, no stop on the line.

techniques.evidence: apps/stage/src/voice/session.ts:200 The queue is bounded (player.ts:289), every source is stopped on reset or dispose, and the session stops on unmount (useVoice.ts:189). But a failed middle segment is skipped silently instead of ending the utterance honestly.

apps/stage/src/voice/useVoice.ts:109 When the browser refuses audio without a gesture, the stage shows a visible unlock action and one honest sentence instead of passing silence off as success. The Voice toggle is off by default (toggle.ts:40).

apps/stage/src/voice/player.ts:39 The renderer picks its own lead and reads mouth shapes off the heard audio clock (context time minus output latency). With no timeline it falls back to loudness (session.ts:192).
apps/stage/src/voice/player.ts:164 The surface plays engine-agnostic PCM16 frames and never names an engine.
apps/stage/src/voice/session.ts:4 No caller waits for playback to finish.
apps/stage/src/voice/webaudio.ts:23 Output only. There is no capture path; a search for microphone or getUserMedia found nothing.

pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:721 Every rendered sentence goes out to the live stream with only a format check (read_pcm checks channels, width and rate). Nothing checks for silent or wrong-length output, which is the acceptance signature the technique names for duration-fixed engines like Kokoro.

techniques.evidence: tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:698 A successful render is accepted as is. There is no silent or wrong-length gate and no bounded retry before the audio is sent.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:21 Output is strictly ordered, cancel kills renders in flight, and a failed part ends the line.

tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/engine.py:127 A missing engine is named file by file and kept apart from an EngineError (engine broken). The warm and process engines sit behind one protocol (warm.py:80).

tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:114 RTF is measured on the owner's host. The warm pool exists because a process per sentence pays a model load each time, which treats the process boundary as part of the rate.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:34 Local Kokoro on the operator's install. A dead voice says why and never falls back silently.

tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/text.py:40 Chunk boundary rules cover abbreviations, decimals and closers, with a fold-under size and the first-chunk comma cut (text.py:89). The markup door sits upstream in the brain (grammar.rs), outside this context.

tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/visemes.py:176 Timings come from the model's own durations, with a tiling check, a pause time map and a measured LEAD_S offset. A timeline that fails verification is dropped and the audio still ships (visemes.py:424).
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/blend.py:2 The voice is authored from a stored recipe plus sha256 provenance, with no clone. blend.py is not in the context's listed files but lives in its package.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/sidecar.py:7 The protocol takes say and cancel only. There is no capture.
tools/voice/shadowrunr_voice/engine.py:2 The sidecar never opens an audio device.

pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/service.rs:1086 The hub sends each rendered part to the stage without an acceptance check, and the cloud renderer in the same module only rejects empty audio (elevenlabs.rs:486). A generative cloud render that is degenerate can therefore reach an unattended live audience with every status green.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/service.rs:1086 No acceptance stage sits immediately behind the Renderer seam. The ElevenLabs adapter only checks !audio_base64.is_empty().
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/renderer.rs:67 One output seam with a scripted test fake. Missing files are degraded by name, not crash-looped (probe.rs:5).

crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/service.rs:681 The queue is bounded and drops the oldest line as queue_full. A failed part skips the rest of the line honestly (service.rs:1120), and lag and render timeouts are bounded.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/service.rs:31 No silent fallback to cloud. The status names the provider.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/mod.rs:18 Voice is off by default, its absence carries a reason, and the stream never waits on it.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/sidecar.rs:478 Records which source produced each part's timing (none or durations) instead of fabricating one.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/service.rs:2 Only hosted live-run says are voiced. /voice clients follow; they cannot request speech.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/service.rs:6 Nothing waits on playback finishing.
crates/shadowrunr-daemon/src/voice/renderer.rs:72 The seam speaks only. A search for microphone or getUserMedia found nothing.
